stories.headline: Canada’s budget proposes C$6.5 billion to retool forestry
stories.body: Canada’s November 5 federal budget proposes C$6.5 billion in forest-sector support over six years beginning in 2027–28. The largest piece is C$4 billion on a cash basis through Export Development Canada’s Canada Account for a new Forestry…

stories.headline: Maine honors logging brothers for stewardship of working forests
stories.body: Will and Don Cole of Sidney, who operate the family logging business Trees Ltd., received Maine’s 2026 Austin H. Wilkins Forest Stewardship Award. The state’s November 6 announcement highlighted their work on public and private woodlands…

stories.headline: Low snow helped some winter logging jobs and limited others
stories.body: A new Forest Service summary of the 2026 western snow drought describes a split in winter operations. Staff reported easier access to some logging and management sites, while other jobs were limited because they needed frozen ground or more…

featuredResource.title: PATH 4.0 — Planning & Analysis in Timber Harvesting
featuredResource.description: PATH is a logging-business profitability app that brings overhead, equipment, labor, fuel and production into one analysis. Enter business and product figures to examine profit or loss for a selected operating period or job.
